text: At its meeting held November 9, 10, and 12, 2021, City Council appointed the following five members to the Board for a term of office from November 15, 2021 to November 10, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Claudia Brabazon Matthew Cole Cynthia Holmes Ivan Hon Matthew Lombardi As part of this process, Vanessa Choy's term of office on the Board came to an end effective November 14, 2021.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo received the item for information.
